instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use Shadcn 'Card' components with rounded corners and soft shadows. Build custom border-collapse style grids for data to convey a technical, 'Control Room' feel. The Aadhaar card is an official document; the UI must look like a high-end secure vault or terminal. Enforce strict data-testid attributes.

layout_and_spacing.container_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid - Dense, precise, highly structured. Max-w-5xl mx-auto.
layout_and_spacing.grid_rules: Use border-collapse style layouts for data sections. Grid items must use border-r and border-b to create a technical table-like feel.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px to 4px). Avoid heavy rounding to maintain an official, technical appearance.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Stack sections vertically on mobile. Move to a 2-column layout on md (Left: Scanner/Upload/Preview, Right: OCR Results Grid).

surface_strategies.main_container: Solid #FFFFFF background, strict 1px border (#E2E8F0), subtle shadow-sm. No glassmorphism. Pure function.
surface_strategies.data_cells: Flat backgrounds. No shadows. Grid borders separate all data points.
surface_strategies.upload_zone: Relative positioning. Implement 'viewfinder' or 'reticle' corners using absolute positioned pseudo-elements or divs. Background is very light grey (#F8FAFC). On drag-over: background shifts to light primary blue tint.

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#00227A] font-medium tracking-wide rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#94A3B8] text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2

upload_dropzone.structure: Min height 320px. Flex column center. Reticle corners in the 4 edges to look like a document scanner.
upload_dropzone.text: font-sans text-sm text-slate-600. Emphasize 'Drag & Drop Document' or 'Capture via Camera'.
upload_dropzone.actions: Provide two distinct action buttons below the dropzone: 'Upload File' (PDF/Image) and 'Camera Capture'.

ocr_results_panel.structure: CSS Grid layout (grid-cols-2). Each data point (Name, DOB, Gender, Aadhaar Number) gets its own cell with border-b and border-r.
ocr_results_panel.masking_instructions: Aadhaar number MUST be displayed with 'XXXX XXXX ' prefix (e.g., XXXX XXXX 1234). Use mono font for perfect alignment.
ocr_results_panel.status_banner: Small full-width banner at top of results or bottom of image preview. Green background/text for Success, Red for Failure.

security_notice.structure: Small text at the absolute bottom of the main container.
security_notice.style: text-xs text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-2 justify-center py-4 border-t border-slate-200
security_notice.content: End-to-End Encrypted. Images are processed entirely in memory and never stored.

animations.scanner_beam: During loading/OCR phase, overlay a 2px horizontal blue line (#002FA7) with a subtle drop shadow that animates continuously up and down over the uploaded image preview container.
animations.loading_spinner: Minimalist circle spinner or technical ASCII-style loader in the status area.
animations.transitions: Very fast, crisp transitions (150ms). No bounce. Use linear or ease-in-out.
